info.title: MultiConnectCLI
info.description: MultiConnect Cloud CLI — deploy servers, APIs and websites, and check on databases, from your terminal or CI pipeline

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Link this folder to a deployment and save how to build it (writes multiconnect.json)

options.name: --key
options.description: Access key. Defaults to MC_ACCESS_KEY, otherwise you are asked.

options.name: --secret
options.description: Not accepted: set MC_ACCESS_SECRET, or you are asked.

options.name: --deployment
options.description: Deployment name or id to link, when the key is attached to several.

options.name: --build-path
options.description: Build output folder or .zip, relative to this folder (the master build for master-worker servers).

options.name: --build-command
options.description: Command that produces the build, e.g. "npm run build". Omit to build yourself.

options.name: --worker-build-path
options.description: Master-worker servers: the worker build folder or .zip.

options.name: --worker-build-command
options.description: Master-worker servers: command that produces the worker build.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing multiconnect.json without asking.

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Build, upload and roll out a new version of the linked deployment

options.name: --config
options.description: Change deployment settings interactively before deploying (applied in the same rollout).

options.name: --tag
options.description: A label for this build, e.g. a version or commit SHA (websites and servers).

options.name: --skip-build
options.description: Do not run the build command; upload what is already in the build path.

options.name: --no-rollback
options.description: Leave a failed rollout in place instead of restoring the previous build.

options.name: --no-wait
options.description: Return once the rollout has started instead of waiting for it to finish.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Minutes to wait for the rollout before giving up (the rollout itself carries on).

options.name: --yes
options.description: Do not ask for confirmation.

options.name: --keep-previous
options.description: Servers: keep the build being replaced running for game clients built for it — a number of days (1-90) or 'until-retired'.

options.name: --approve-build-command
options.description: Run the build command from multiconnect.json even if it has not been approved on this machine before (for CI; check it first).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the state of the linked deployment and its containers

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show connection details for the linked deployment

commands.name: balance
commands.description: Show the account's credit balance and how long it lasts

commands.name: analytics
commands.description: Show cost, plan usage and per-container resource use for the linked deployment

commands.name: versions
commands.description: List the builds the linked server deployment is running, and retire kept ones

commands.name: retire
commands.description: Retire a kept build: its containers drain and are removed after the grace period

options.name: --yes
options.description: Do not ask for confirmation.

arguments.name: BUILDNUMBER
arguments.description: The build number to retire, e.g. 1.0.0.8 (see 'multiconnect versions').
